title: 第25章 子湮的三拳戏耍五雄第26章 陨心梦泽梦幻花海
slug: 全球守护灵开局获得东皇帝俊
content_zh:
拓跋荣闻言惊恐的急忙摇头说道：“不行不行，你什么实力，什么力量心里没点数吗？”
“真要挨了你三拳，那恐怕都得成肉饼吧？”
“让我们接你三拳，你还不如现在就杀了我们算了。”
“我算是看出来了，你根本就不打算放过我们，刚才就是在戏耍我们！”
“来吧~要杀就杀吧~”
说完死猪不怕开水烫的，闭紧了双眼，等待着死亡降临。
赢天无语的看着闭眼等死的拓跋荣。
他是真想不通，拓跋荣等人连挨他三拳的勇气都没有。
是怎么有勇气，来算计他们的。
难道这就是所谓的，膨胀心理？
子湮见状嘲讽道：“呵~既然你们不敢接赢天的三拳，那就接我三拳好了。”
杨乾一脸戏谑的说道：“对~只要你们接了子湮三拳，再说出高瑞他们的下落。”
“我们这次就放过你们。”
拓跋荣闻言瞬间睁开眼睛说道：“真的？不对…要是万一你们，中途反悔怎么办？”
赢天不屑的说道：“就凭你们还没资格，让我们反悔~”
李智笑着说道：“哈哈~放宽心啦~我们九皇殿向来一言九鼎，从未食言。”
刘枢同样点头道：“对，我们可不会做那种影响声誉的事。”
拓跋荣与完颜庆几人对视一眼，在心里分析了一下利弊之后，点头道：“行！来吧~”
说完，身着灵衣，排好防御架势，等待着子湮即将到来的攻击。
子湮咧嘴一笑道：“这一拳，你可要接好了，别一拳就不行了。”

拓跋荣不屑的说道：“呵呵~你以为，你是赢天啊？”
“别说挨上你一拳，就是十拳又如何？”
子湮闻言挑眉说道：“哦~什么时候，你们这些臭虫，变得这么自信了？”
“希望一会儿，你还能跟我这么说~”
说完瞬间出现在拓跋荣面前，一拳直击拓跋荣的护在胸前的双臂。
砰！！！
双方刚一接触，便发出一声爆响。
拓跋荣整个人瞬间倒飞数十米远。
砰砰砰！！！
期间更是撞断了七八棵两人合抱的大树。
整个人在地面砸出了，一个三米深的大坑，这才停了下来。
子湮看着远处的大坑戏谑道：“怎么…刚才不是叫的挺欢吗？”
“现在就不行了？”
话音刚落，拓跋荣便颤颤巍巍的爬出了深坑。
站起身后，开始缓缓的抬头看向子湮，正准备说些什么。
便感觉喉咙突然一阵腥甜。
噗~
一口鲜血，瞬间喷涌而出。
吐完血后缓了一口气的拓跋荣，耸拉着双手，恐惧的看向了子湮。
结结巴巴的说道：“你…你怎么变得，这…这么厉害了？”
content_en:
Hearing this, Tuobarong hurriedly shook his head in horror and said, "No, no, no, don't you know what your strength is?"
"If I really get punched by you three times, I'm afraid I'll be turned into a meat pie, right?"
"Let us take three punches from you. You might as well kill us now."
"I can finally see that you have no intention of letting us go. You were just teasing us!"
"Come on~ If you want to kill, just kill~"
After saying that the dead pig was not afraid of being scalded by boiling water, he closed his eyes tightly and waited for death to come.
Yingtian looked speechlessly at Tuobarong who closed his eyes and waited for death.
He really couldn't understand that Tuobarong and others didn't even have the courage to take three punches from him.
How did you have the courage to plot against them?
Is this what is called expansion psychology?
Seeing this, Zi Yan mocked: "Ha~ Since you don't dare to accept Yingtian's three punches, then just accept my three punches."
Yang Qian said with a joking face: "Yes~ As long as you receive three punches from Zi Yan, then tell the whereabouts of Gao Rui and others."
"We will let you go this time."
Tuobarong opened his eyes immediately after hearing this and said, "Really? No...what if you guys regret it midway?"
Yingtian said disdainfully: "Just because you are not qualified, let us regret it~"
Li Zhi said with a smile: "Haha~ relax~ We at the Nine Emperors Palace always keep our word and never break our word."
Liu Shu also nodded and said: "Yes, we will not do anything that affects our reputation."
Tuobarong and Wanyanqing looked at each other, and after mentally analyzing the pros and cons, they nodded and said, "Okay! Come on~"
After saying that, he put on his spiritual clothes and got into a defensive posture, waiting for Zi Yan's upcoming attack.
Ziyan grinned and said, "You have to take this punch well. Don't just punch me."
Tuobarong said disdainfully: "Haha~ Do you think you are the winner?"
"Let alone one punch from you, so what if it's ten punches?"
Zi Yan raised his eyebrows when he heard this and said, "Oh~ when did you bugs become so confident?"
"I hope you can still say this to me later~"
After saying that, he appeared in front of Tuobarong and punched Tuobarong directly on the arms protecting his chest.
Bang! ! !
As soon as the two sides came into contact, there was an explosion.
Tuobarong's entire body instantly flew dozens of meters away.
Bang bang bang! ! !
During this period, seven or eight large trees were broken by two people hugging each other.
The whole person was smashed into the ground, a big pit three meters deep, and then it stopped.
Ziyan looked at the big pit in the distance and said jokingly: "Why...didn't you scream happily just now?"
"Isn't it possible now?"
As soon as he finished speaking, Tuobarong climbed out of the pit tremblingly.
After standing up, he began to slowly look up at Zi Yan, about to say something.
I felt a sudden sweetness in my throat.
Phew~
A mouthful of blood spurted out instantly.
Tuobarong, who took a breath after vomiting blood, clasped his hands and looked at Ziyan in fear.
He stammered: "You...how did you become so...so powerful?"
